title: Resolve native agents and execution profiles through a trusted Registry
goal: Select eligible persistent agents and supported native settings while keeping identity, provider, model, capabilities and invocation metadata distinct.
scope: Implement Agent, Provider, ModelOffering, ProfileSettings, ExecutionProfile and Pool projections. Preserve stable agent IDs, instructions, enabled/default settings and per-model native effort sets; represent Codex, Claude, Glm, Scripted and Other(Text) provider kinds without pretending all adapters are already available.

Make Registry.pool(constraints), profile(agent, settings) and capabilities(profile, workspace) trusted operations over explicit discovery/probe facts. StaticDependencyProbe checks executables/adapters/dependencies without inference, with typed exclusion reasons; effective capabilities include all nine model values and remain constrained by actual workspace/backend enforcement.

Create native discovery/probe contracts and explicit Scripted identity/offerings fixtures for Registry. Keep Invocation requested/sent/reported ProfileSettings distinct from ExecutionProfile, keyed by agent/provider version/model/family/native effort. The actual Scripted executor is W1-0017; complete Codex discovery/execution is W1-0018.
acceptance: Through the real Registry consumer, explicit probe/discovery inputs expose per-model offerings, identity/version/capabilities and typed exclusions. Registry.profile denies unsupported settings and invalid pins before inference; W1-0006 later demonstrates their use in admission.
Replacing StaticDependencyProbe with a materially different deterministic probe changes eligibility through Registry while preserving the same invariants and recorded policy/input provenance.

Missing reported model/effort/family is visible as unknown, distinct from requested/sent settings. A local discovery/fixture run neither authenticates by copying credentials nor performs a model turn.
evidence: Commit 33fe98acdc0d4b1012132443fa21d58b2fa79fda in main; required offline build/fmt/clippy/test passed (32 integration tests plus one compile-fail); legacy-scan passed; see ymp-docs/registry-implementation.md for contract evidence and scope limits.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.1, 3.4 (ExecutionProfile and Invocation), 4 (Registry), 5.1 (ReadinessProbe), 5.7 (ExecutionBackend), A5 and R-2/R-3/R-9. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/identity.rs, crates/ymp-kernel/src/registry.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/src/readiness.rs. W1-0001 provides events/provenance and W1-0002 user constraints. Use StaticDependencyProbe plus a substantially different deterministic probe through Registry.

Each ModelOffering preserves its own native effort values. Family/version metadata has a stated source; absent native data stays unknown and yields an explicit fallback/denial when a decision requires it. An agent has persistent instructions/defaults, not permanent role authority.
This Registry implementation does not claim an executor exists. W1-0017 builds Scripted, W1-0018 builds Codex, W6-0001 builds Claude and W6-0002 builds Glm against this contract.
